Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.Requisitos Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação. Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas. Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber. Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencialInformações Adicionais Tipo de contrato: CLT. Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

title: Senior Api Engineer
description: About the Company: Headspace Health is the world's most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively. Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. By harnessing the power and convenience of a smartphone, Headspace Health is able to provide access to high-quality care to anyone, anywhere, in order to reduce symptoms of stress, anxiety, and depression.Role summary: Lead the design and operation of APIs that power Server-Driven UI for Flutter clients while owning backend services across the stack. You'll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.Key responsibilities: Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting. Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks. Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices. Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality. Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation. Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing). Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards). Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow. Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility. Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience: 7+ years building production microservices and APIs. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design. Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems. Hands-on development inTypeScriptfor backend services. Proven RESTful API design and contract experience. Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies. Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents). Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers). Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification. Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties. Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.). Good spoken EnglishNice to have: Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources. Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts). Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics. Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos). Background in personalization/experimentation systems. Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals: Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements. Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns. Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems. Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Health/Sport budget Remote work Flexible PTO Global offices Fun, positive, collaborative environment!Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
- Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
- Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
- Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued.Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Senior Api Engineer
description: About the Company: Headspace Health is the world's most accessible and comprehensive digital mental health and wellbeing platform. Headspace Health will democratize mental health and wellbeing so people around the world are supported by a full spectrum of affordable care. In addition to its vast library of mindfulness and meditation content, our behavioral health system offers emotional support, guidance, therapy, and medication from professional coaches, licensed therapists, and psychiatrists, respectively. Our mission is to create a world where mental health is never an obstacle. You'll design stable UI contracts and compose client payloads, be comfortable diving into other backend codebases to implement features and fix production issues, participate in the on-call rotation to keep services healthy and low-latency, and drive team capability for SDUI.Key responsibilities: Design and implement robust RESTful APIs for SDUI, auth, and rate limiting. Implement composition/templating logic that returns client-ready UI payloads with capability-aware fallbacks. Champion SDUI capability across the team: coach engineers, run hands-on workshops, create onboarding/docs, and promote SDUI best practices. Work across multiple backend repositories: add features, refactor, and maintain code quality. Operate production services: own SLAs, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and participate in on-call rotation. Improve reliability and performance (caching, CDN strategies, Redis, profiling, autoscaling, and load testing). Build and maintain CI/CD, testing, and observability (metrics, tracing, logs, dashboards). Integrate personalization, experimentation hooks, and feature flags into the delivery flow. Collaborate closely with mobile/web teams to define contracts and client compatibility. Mentor peers, lead design reviews, and drive API and schema governance and backward-compatibility practices.Required skills & experience: 7+ years building production microservices and APIs. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with active participation in team ceremonies and the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, and design. Strong Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) experience, including effective use of abstraction and dependency injection patterns to build modular, testable, and maintainable backend systems. Hands-on development inTypeScriptfor backend services. Proven RESTful API design and contract experience. Solid experience with databases and caching technologies, such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Redis, with an understanding of data modeling, query performance, and cache strategies. Strong withAWS(API Gateway/Lambda or ECS/EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS/ElastiCache or equivalents). Experience with containerization using Docker (image build, Docker Compose, registries, running services in containers). Strong testing experience, including automated testing and manual verification. Experience with production support: alerting, runbooks, incident management, and on-call duties. Familiar with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability tooling (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, etc.). Good spoken EnglishNice to have: Terraform or other IaC for managing AWS resources. Experience instrumenting endpoints and surfacing behavior in analytics platforms such as Amplitude (event schemas, dashboards, alerts). Experience using Statsig, Grafana, and Sentry for experimentation, dashboards, error tracking, and incident diagnostics. Protobuf experience (service/event schema management via service-protos). Background in personalization/experimentation systems. Hands-on development in Python for backend services.Hiring signals: Examples of evolving APIs without breaking clients and measurable reliability/performance improvements. Proven track record of mentoring and up-skilling engineers—especially enabling teams to adopt and own SDUI patterns. Evidence of effective on-call ownership: resolved incidents, improved runbooks/alerts, postmortems. Code that shows strong testing, observability, and cross-repo contributions.Perks: We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Health/Sport budget Remote work Flexible PTO Global offices Fun, positive, collaborative environment!Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Network Management:Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operational models. Technical Proficiency:Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership:Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education:Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages:Fluency inEnglishis essential for regional and global coordination. title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About Client Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action.The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance.Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics.About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement.Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions.How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals.Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it's an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let's build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS) - Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory - Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso - Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretasAutomação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Cybersecurity Project Manager
description:
TheProject Managerin our cybersecurity/IT services division will lead the planning and execution of complex technology projects, ensuring they are deliveredon time, within scope, and within budget. This role acts as a bridge between technical teams (network/security engineers, developers, analysts) and business stakeholders. The Project Manager is responsible for coordinating cross-functional efforts in a dynamic environment, often managingmultiple projectsor client engagements simultaneously, aligning them with strategic goals and the latest industry practices (e.G.,Agile methodology, cloud deployments, security compliance ). Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution:Define projectscope, objectives, and deliverablesfor cybersecurity and IT infrastructure projects. Develop detailed project plans with timelines, milestones, and resource allocation. Manage the full project lifecycle from initiation to closure, adapting to changing requirements or priorities. Team Leadership & Coordination:Lead cross-functional teams (security engineers, IT staff, developers, client representatives) to ensure collaboration and timely task completion. Assign responsibilities, oversee day-to-day project activities, and maintain team motivation and productivity in both on-site andremote/hybrid work environments. Budget & Risk Management:Manage project budgets and control costs. Identify and mitigate risks and issues proactively;
implement contingency plans to address potential project roadblocks or security concerns. Ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards and regulations (e.G., data privacy laws, security policies) throughout project execution. Stakeholder Communication:Serve as the primary contact for internal and external stakeholders. Provide regular project status updates, performance metrics, and risk assessments to clients, senior management, and team members. Facilitate meetings, gather feedback, and manage expectations to maintain alignment with project goals and client needs. Quality Assurance & Delivery:Ensure project deliverables meet the required quality and security standards. Coordinate testing, user acceptance, and security reviews on project outputs (e.G., new system implementations, policy rollouts). Oversee documentation (project plans, reports, compliance evidence) and obtain stakeholder sign-offs. Post-Project Support & Continuous Improvement:Oversee transition of completed projects to operational teams. Conduct post-mortems and lessons-learned sessions to identify improvement opportunities. Stay informed on emergingindustry trends(likeAI integration in project management ,DevSecOps, and newcollaboration tools ) to continually enhance project management practices. Required Qualifications & Skills: Education & Professional Knowledge:Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business (or related field). Strong understanding ofIT systems, networks, and cybersecurity fundamentalsto effectively communicate with technical teams and align projects with security best practices. Project Management Skills:Proven ability to manage complex IT or security projects usingproject management methodologies(Waterfall and Agile). Proficiency with project management tools (e.G., MS Project, Jira, or Trello) for planning, tracking, and reporting. Skilled in developing project documentation and managing project scope changes. Leadership & Communication:Excellent leadership and organizational skills. Demonstrated experience coordinatingcross-functional teams, managing resources, and resolving conflicts. Exceptional communication skills to interface with diverse stakeholders and present project updates in a clear, concise manner. Analytical & Problem-Solving:Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Capacity to anticipate challenges, craft mitigation strategies, and adapt to evolving project needs. Must be detail-oriented but also able to see the big picture to ensure projects deliver strategic value. Preferred Qualifications: Advanced Knowledge:Familiarity withcybersecurity frameworks(e.G., NIST CSF, ISO 27001) and regulatory standards (e.G., GDPR, HIPAA) to integrate compliance into project plans. Understanding of modern IT trends such ascloud computing projects, digital transformation, orAI-driven solutionsis a plus. Industry Experience:Prior experience in anIT services or consulting environment, managing projects for external clients or within large enterprise settings. Background innetwork/security infrastructure projectsor software development projects is advantageous. Methodologies:Certifications or hands-on experience withAgile/Scrummethodologies (e.G., Certified Scrum Master) orDevOps/DevSecOpspractices. Experience Requirements: Experience:7+ yearsof experience in project management within the IT or cybersecurity domain. This should include successfully managingmultiple full project lifecycles, with at least several projects related toIT security, networking, or software/IT infrastructure. Leadership experience in a matrixed or cross-functional team environment is essential. Certifications: Project Management Certifications:Project Management Professional (PMP)orPRINCE2(highly preferred / required) as evidence of formal project management training and expertise. Security/Technical Certifications:Certifications such asCertified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) ,Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), orCertified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)are a plus, signifying an understanding of cybersecurity principles and compliance. Agile/Other Certs:Additional certifications likeCertified Scrum Master (CSM)orITIL Foundationare beneficial and reflect a commitment to industry best practices.

standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! description:

Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details: Engagement type :Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. title: Software Engineer
description:

You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making. You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‐to‐end reliability.Key Responsibilities Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights. Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI. Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making;
ensure usability, consistency, and performance. Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows. Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement. Quality & Reliability: Perform end‐to‐end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services;
monitor performance anditerate based on feedback. Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas. Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python. Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation. Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages). Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming). Hands‐on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.G., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing). Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus. Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.Tech Stack (Indicative) Languages: Java, Python, C++ Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization Frontend: Component‐based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows) Testing: Unit, integration, E2E;
CI/CD pipelines Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuningWhat We're Looking For Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset. Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs. Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínuaDIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ: ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito. ️Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. Proficiência em Python para análise de dados, experimentação e modelagem. Vivência com experimentação e testes A/B em ambientes de produto. Capacidade de comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Experiência em produtos digitais com alto volume de dados. Noções de MLOps. Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.Diferenciais Vivência com BigQuery ou data lakes. Experiência prévia em e-commerce, marketplace ou plataformas de discovery. Experiência em observabilidade e monitoramento da qualidade da busca. Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling. Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.Perfil esperado Forte mentalidade de produto e experiência do usuário. Perfil analítico, curioso e orientado a impacto. Autonomia para conduzir iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta. Capacidade de influenciar decisões técnicas e de produto com dados. Boa colaboração em times multidisciplinares.#SeleçãoSBF #VempraSBF

description: Título da posição:Data Analyst V BRL Tipo de contratação:Temporário via agência Modelo de trabalho:Home officeVisão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. title: Engenheiro(A) De Ia (Generative Ai & Agentic Systems)
description: A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.O DESAFIO:Orquestração e Agentes:Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizandoLangGraphouAgent Squadpara decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados. Infraestrutura Cloud:Gerenciar deploys em ambientesAWSouAzuree integrar modelos viaAWS BedrockouAzure OpenAI Service, priorizando arquiteturas Serverless e Event-Driven. AI Guardrails:Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos. Avaliação Sistemática:Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção. Eficiência de Custos:Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:Linguagens:Domínio avançado dePythoneJavapara automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA. DevOps/MLOps:Experiência comDocker ,Containerizatione práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem. Educação:Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa emExplainable AI (XAI) .O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito. ️ Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama. Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais. title: Arquiteto(A) De Software
description:
BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!O que você deve ter? Desenvolver soluções técnicas que atendam a requisitos de escalabilidade, desempenho e segurança;
Atuar como referência técnica em projetos, colaborando com equipes de engenharia e produto;
Garantir a qualidade docódigo e a integridade das soluções, apoiando revisões e boas práticas;
Utilizar ferramentas deautomação e CI/CD para assegurar integridade e performance dos sistemas;
Analisar arquiteturas de sistemas e processos existentes, identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias;
Documentar arquiteturasutilizando padrões reconhecidos (ex. C4) e disseminar boas práticas entre times;
Conduzir discussões técnicas e apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica junto a stakeholders de tecnologia. Requisitos Técnicos Domínio de arquiteturas de software avançadas, incluindo microserviços, serverless e monólitos modulares;
Experiência sólida em desenho de soluções escaláveis, seguras e resilientes;
Vivência prática com ferramentas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
Capacidade de atuação em equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo colaboração e qualidade técnica;
Visão sistêmica sobre impacto de decisões arquiteturais em ambientes de TI complexos. Espanhol avançado (obrigatório), para atuação direta com stakeholders e clientes LATAM. Diferenciais Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem em pelo menos um dos principais provedores (AWS, Azure ou GCP);
Conhecimento em padrõesde documentação arquitetural, como C4;
Experiência em consultoria, atuando em múltiplos contextos e clientes;
Inglês avançado, para interação em projetos internacionais. Espanhol avançadoO que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas: - Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!Como é trabalhar na BRQ?Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar!
